result:
The foley session is off the schedule. Updated the two design docs that carry it: `docs/DESIGNER_QUEUE.md`'s Q-31 entry now says the next recording session — plant is the verb most needing it — waits until you've picked a look in the Q-14 session, and `docs/design/10-audio-direction.md` splits the plant sound's sourcing note the same way: the recording half is paused, but hunting for a CC0 candidate isn't, since that doesn't need you.

Nothing about the shipped set changes and neither the playtest nor the first release depends on this — same as when Q-31 was first filed.

I also re-checked `CREDITS.md` against every file actually sitting in `assets/audio/` — still complete and clean, nothing new to log there.

One thing already on your board, not new: the plant-sound sourcing task filed to me off the design note is still queued and doesn't need you either — I just don't have network/API access from this worktree to actually run the CC0 search this session, so that part waits for a normal build session.

Done, uncommitted in the worktree (house rule — I don't commit). Nothing pushed. Safe to hand off.
